messages:
ava (Docs): Opening a small PR to tighten SOC2/audit-log wording, add a Go SDK example for attaching audit metadata, and include a brief migration note for the new retention API. Need quick legal + security check before merge.

cory (Security): Quick asks: 1) use 'recommended' for any retention windows unless contractually guaranteed; 2) mention append-only storage + integrity monitoring; 3) call out redaction/tokenization options for PII.

rachel (Legal): Agree. Also add that retention may be extended for legal/regulatory holds and that customer contracts can set retention. Avoid hard guarantees in public docs.

ava (Docs): Draft copy I'm planning to add:

"Audit logs: Redwood retains audit logs to support security investigations, compliance, and contractual obligations. Recommended retention windows are 90 days for development environments and 24 months for production. Actual retention is configurable and may be extended to meet legal or contractual requirements. For private deployments customers can configure retention via the console or the retention API. Sensitive fields may be redacted or tokenized before long-term storage; see the data redaction guide."

mike (DevEx): tiny nit: use "Redwood retains" (good). Can you add a short Go example showing an audit header? We'll also need a curl example showing the v1 -> v2 retention payload transform for migration notes.

ava (Docs): Go SDK snippet I'll include:

```go
// attach audit metadata for traceability and correlation
resp, err := client.Generate(ctx, api.GenerateParams{
    Model: "rw-instruct-1",
    Input: "Summarize this",
    Headers: map[string]string{"x-redwood-audit-id": "org-55-evt-2026"},
})
if err != nil { /* handle */ }
```

ava (Docs): Migration curl example:

```bash
# legacy v1
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/retention -d '{"days":365}'
# new v2
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v2/retention -d '{"policy_name":"prod-default","retention_days":365}'
```

cory (Security): Add one sentence for auditors: "Audit logs are stored in append-only storage with integrity monitoring; deletions require authorization and are logged."

rachel (Legal): I'll sign off on that language if you prefix recommended windows with 'recommended' and add: 'Customer contracts and applicable law may override these recommendations.' Also don't publish retention as a fixed promise.

ava (Docs): Updated. Also fixed the redaction link anchor (it should be /docs/data-redaction#audit-logs). Planning to mark the PR ready once legal signs off.

infra-bot: docs CI: build ✔, staging ✔. PR queued for merge after final review.

ava (Docs): Thanks everyone, I'll merge after legal signs off and add a short changelog entry referencing the retention API docs and redaction guide.
